title: From the Velodrome to Space: US Track Champion Christina Birch Named NASA Mission Pilot
content:
After swapping skinsuits for spacesuits, ex-track cyclist and Team USA member Christina Birch prepares for her first spaceflight with NASA in 2027.

Read the full article at From the Velodrome to Space: US Track Champion Christina Birch Named NASA Mission Pilot on Velo.
